description: Funzzy dependency update grouping (TASK-0108): updates arrive as reviewable, single-purpose PRs — never one opaque batch.

packageRules.description: Watcher/process-adjacent crates (notify, nix, signal-hook, libc, …) are behavior-sensitive: every major is its own PR, minors grouped per crate line.
Cargo lockfile maintenance only (no version bumps) monthly.
Nix inputs move together, separate from all code dependencies.
